title: FlockOS release manifest (dl/flockos/manifest.json payload), schema 1
description: The document the release pipeline signs and publishes as dl/flockos/manifest.json (ADR-0009). Published inside the device-agent's envelope: {"payload": "<base64 of this document>", "signature": "<base64 Ed25519 signature>"}, at most 64 KiB, signed over the message "flockos-manifest:v1\nflockos/manifest.json\n<sha256 hex of the payload>". The device-agent reads channels, releases and images; FlockFlasher reads boards. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a change that breaks a reader raises schema.

issued_at.description: When the pipeline signed this document (UTC). A reader refuses a document older than the one it last accepted.

channels.description: The FlockOS version each channel offers. Test devices follow test, all others production. Promoting a release moves production to its version.

releases.description: The releases a channel names, by version; no others.

boards.description: FlockFlasher's view of the production release, in the shape it already parses (SupportedBoard). A target that fits several boards (rpi-arm64: Pi 4, 400, 5, CM4, CM5) lists its images under each.

build_id.description: BUILD_ID of the release's os-release: <UTC build time>Z-g<commit>.

min_agent.description: The oldest device-agent that may install this release's bundles. An older agent updates itself first.

images.description: Every image of the release, by IMAGE_ID (os-release), which is also the RAUC compatible.

image.description: The raw disk image, <image-id>-<version>.img.gz, as FlockFlasher writes it.

bundle.description: The RAUC bundle, <image-id>-<version>.raucb. The device-agent downloads it, checks size and sha256, and hands it to RAUC, which checks the signature and compatible. The installer has none.

latestImages.description: One entry per image of the board, base first: FlockFlasher before WP-2.7 takes latestImages[0].

imageInfo.description: FlockFlasher's ImageInfo, plus image_id, variant and kernel for its variant choice (WP-2.7).

file.description: The last path segment of download.

osvariant.description: How FlockFlasher writes it: always image, a raw image with the .flock copied onto its FLOCKOS partition (ADR-0004).

sha256.description: Of the .img.gz file, as download serves it.

update.description: The RAUC bundle's URL; empty for the installer.
